text:
anika: Heads-up: soft-launch social push for 'Inference Unlocked' webinar on Wed 9:00am PT. Need short X thread, LI thread, and partner amplification plan. Who can own copies + scheduling? cc @sam @diego
sam: I can write X thread + schedule. Plan: 4 tweets — teaser, stat, testimonial, CTA. Need 16:9 hero (1200x675), 1:1 clip, and 15s vertical for stories.
diego: I'll handle LinkedIn thread and partner tags. Can we make the benchmark narrative two tight bullets: latency + cost? Partners want a quick one-liner they can reshare.
morgan: Assets: hero jpg, square png, 30s mp4, 15s vertical. Also produce plain-text caption for partner reposts (no links).
anika: Partners: @acmeinc, @edgeplatform. Add partner handle list to the doc. CTA link: social-bot, what's the registration URL?
social-bot: Registration URL created -> https://redwood.ai/events/inference-unlocked?utm_source=social
sam: Suggested X schedule: Wed 9:00am PT (live), Wed 1:00pm PT (nudge), Thu 9:00am PT (last call), Thu 3:00pm PT (recap). Pin FAQ reply with webinar time conversions.
diego: LI thread draft (short):
diego: "Inference that fits your stack — predictable latency, measurable cost savings. Join our webinar for benchmarks + live Q&A. Register: https://redwood.ai/events/inference-unlocked?utm_campaign=inference_unlocked&utm_source=linkedin"
morgan: Legal check on stat: saying "~30% average token cost reduction" needs signoff. legal-bot: Approved for aggregate stat when attributed to internal benchmark. Backup copy without stat attached.
anika: Playbook for first 48h: 1) monitor top 20 replies, 2) route potential demo requests to AE channel, 3) send top prospects DM with scheduling link. Assign owners: sam (Twitter 0-24h), diego (LinkedIn 0-24h), morgan (assets + partner kit), anika (overall).
sam: I'll create short alt text for images and 3 caption variants (formal, short, and partner).
morgan: I'll export 15s vertical + add stat overlay option. Need approval by Tue EOD.
anika: Can someone add UTM param rules to the doc? use utm_campaign=inference_unlocked, utm_source=(twitter|linkedin|partner), utm_medium=social.
social-bot: Reminder: upload final assets to #marketing-assets by 2026-04-06T20:00Z
diego: Quick ask: should we seed to our micro-influencers? Recommend 5 contacts; will DM assets.
anika: Yes, seed list approved. Use partner copy (no links) for their repost.
sam: Drafting X thread now, will drop in the doc for signoff.
morgan: :white_check_mark:
anika: Thanks team — final checklist: assets, captions, UTMs, schedule, owners, partner kit. We'll run the soft-launch cadence and measure CTR + signups in first 48h.
